biotools.summary: Infers maternal and paternal transmitted and non-transmitted alleles from phased trio genotype data. The package supports SNP-level analyses of genetic nurture and transgenerational effects. It interoperates with Bioconductor VCF infrastructure through support for VariantAnnotation::VCF objects and returns R objects for downstream analysis.
